name: pocketbase
label: Pocketbase
description: Interact with your PocketBase instance using superuser credentials.

host.label: Host
host.description: Your Pocketbase host URL (e.g., https://pocketbase.your-project.com). The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

email.label: Superuser Email
email.description: The email address of your Pocketbase superuser

password.label: Superuser Password
password.description: The password of your Pocketbase superuser

getFullList.label: Get Full List
getFullList.description: Gets all the data for a given collection

collection.label: Collection Name
collection.description: The name of the PocketBase collection

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Order attribute(s). Use - for DESC, + for ASC. E.g.: -created,id

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Comma separated fields to return. E.g.: *,expand.relField.name

getList.label: Get List
getList.description: Gets a paginated list of records from a collection

collection.label: Collection Name
collection.description: The name of the PocketBase collection

page.label: Page
page.description: The page (offset) of the paginated list (default: 1)

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Order attribute(s). Use - for DESC, + for ASC. E.g.: -created,id

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Comma separated fields to return. E.g.: *,expand.relField.name

skipTotal.label: Skip Total
skipTotal.description: Skip total counts query for faster results (totalItems and totalPages will be -1)

getRecord.label: Get Record
getRecord.description: Gets a single record by ID from a collection

collection.label: Collection Name
collection.description: The name of the PocketBase collection

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: ID of the record to view

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Comma separated fields to return. E.g.: *,expand.relField.name

deleteRecord.label: Delete Record
deleteRecord.description: Deletes a single record from a collection

collection.label: Collection Name
collection.description: The name of the PocketBase collection

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: ID of the record to delete

pocketbase_list_auth_methods.label: List Auth Methods
pocketbase_list_auth_methods.description: Lists the sign-in methods enabled for an auth collection.

collection.label: Collection
collection.description: Collection name or ID, e.g. "posts". Use List Collections to find it.

pocketbase_download_file.label: Download File
pocketbase_download_file.description: Downloads a file stored in a record's file field.

collection.label: Collection
collection.description: Collection name or ID, e.g. "posts". Use List Collections to find it.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: ID of the record that holds the file. Get List returns record IDs.

fileName.label: File Name
fileName.description: The stored file name exactly as it appears in the record's file field, e.g. "report_52iwbgds7l.pdf".

thumb.label: Thumbnail Size
thumb.description: Image thumbnail size such as "100x100" or "0x300"; it must be listed in the file field's thumb sizes. Leave empty for the original file.

pocketbase_list_collections.label: List Collections
pocketbase_list_collections.description: Lists the collections in the instance with their fields and rules.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Comma separated fields to sort by; prefix with - for descending, e.g. "-created,name".

page.label: Page
page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

pocketbase_get_collection.label: Get Collection
pocketbase_get_collection.description: Gets one collection with its fields, indexes and rules.

collection.label: Collection
collection.description: Collection name or ID, e.g. "posts". Use List Collections to find it.

pocketbase_create_collection.label: Create Collection
pocketbase_create_collection.description: Creates a base, auth or view collection.

type.label: Type
type.description: base stores records, auth stores users that can sign in, view is a read-only SQL view. Defaults to base.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Array of field definitions, e.g. [{ "name": "title", "type": "text", "required": true }, { "name": "views", "type": "number" }]. Types: text, editor, number, bool, email, url, date, autodate, select, file, relation, json, geoPoint, password.

viewQuery.label: View Query
viewQuery.description: SQL SELECT for a view collection; must return an "id" column. Required when Type is view.

rules.label: API Rules
rules.description: Object with any of listRule, viewRule, createRule, updateRule, deleteRule. A filter string limits access, "" allows everyone, null means superusers only (the default).

additionalFields.label: Additional Fields
additionalFields.description: Other collection options sent as-is, e.g. { "indexes": ["CREATE INDEX idx_title ON posts (title)"] } or auth options like passwordAuth and oauth2.

pocketbase_update_collection.label: Update Collection
pocketbase_update_collection.description: Renames a collection, adds fields, or changes its rules and options.

collection.label: Collection
collection.description: Collection name or ID, e.g. "posts". Use List Collections to find it.

name.label: New Name
name.description: New collection name. Leave empty to keep the current name.

addFields.label: Add Fields
addFields.description: Array of new field definitions to append, e.g. [{ "name": "summary", "type": "text" }]. Existing fields are kept.

viewQuery.label: View Query
viewQuery.description: New SQL SELECT for a view collection.

rules.label: API Rules
rules.description: Object with any of listRule, viewRule, createRule, updateRule, deleteRule to change. A filter string limits access, "" allows everyone, null means superusers only.

additionalFields.label: Additional Fields
additionalFields.description: Other collection options sent as-is, e.g. { "indexes": [...] }. A "fields" array here replaces the whole field list.

pocketbase_delete_collection.label: Delete Collection
pocketbase_delete_collection.description: Permanently deletes a collection and all its records.

collection.label: Collection
collection.description: Collection name or ID, e.g. "posts". Use List Collections to find it.

pocketbase_truncate_collection.label: Truncate Collection
pocketbase_truncate_collection.description: Permanently deletes every record in a collection, keeping the collection.

collection.label: Collection
collection.description: Collection name or ID, e.g. "posts". Use List Collections to find it.

pocketbase_preview_view_query.label: Preview View Query
pocketbase_preview_view_query.description: Checks a view collection query and returns the fields and a sample row it would produce.

query.label: Query
query.description: SQL SELECT that returns an "id" column, e.g. "SELECT id, title FROM posts".

pocketbase_list_logs.label: List Logs
pocketbase_list_logs.description: Lists one page of request and app logs.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Comma separated fields to sort by; prefix with - for descending, e.g. "-created,name".

page.label: Page
page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

pocketbase_get_log.label: Get Log
pocketbase_get_log.description: Gets one log entry by ID.

logId.label: Log ID
logId.description: ID of the log entry. List Logs returns it.

pocketbase_create_backup.label: Create Backup
pocketbase_create_backup.description: Creates a new backup of the database and files.

name.label: Name
name.description: Backup file name using only a-z, 0-9, _ and -, ending in .zip, e.g. "before_import.zip". Leave empty for an automatic name.

key.label: Backup Key
key.description: Backup file name, e.g. "pb_backup_20240101.zip". List Backups returns it.

pocketbase_restore_backup.label: Restore Backup
pocketbase_restore_backup.description: Replaces the current data with a stored backup and restarts the instance.

key.label: Backup Key
key.description: Backup file name to restore. List Backups returns it.

pocketbase_delete_backup.label: Delete Backup
pocketbase_delete_backup.description: Permanently deletes a stored backup file.

key.label: Backup Key
key.description: Backup file name to delete. List Backups returns it.

jobId.label: Job ID
jobId.description: Cron job ID, e.g. "__pbLogsCleanup__". List Cron Jobs returns it.

pocketbase_run_sql.label: Run SQL
pocketbase_run_sql.description: Runs a SQL query against the instance database.

query.label: Query
query.description: SQLite SQL, e.g. "SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY status".
